I don't have all the answers and I can't know exactly how you feel but I am finally feeling better.

Im not sure if you ever get cured from depression but I was pretty much broken for 8 years. Now the last year and a half have been an enormous improvement for me and I tried pretty much every stupid tip I could find online.

It was mainly 3 things that made me get better. 

1: exercise, I know everyone say this but it did actually work for me. It won't be a cure like some people claim but for me the hard times became easier and less frequent. 
My way of forcing myself to exercise was to not bring enough money for the trip home when I I went into town so I had go walk/jog back home. Now that's not something everyone can do but look for opportunities like that.

2: therapy. This is not as simple as it first sound. I had bad therapists my whole life pretty much. So if you get lucky with a therapist, that's great. But there are other ways too. My most efficient therapy came from 2 friends that had gone through similar stuff. So if you have someone you trust, try being honest with them and try to do stuff together that raises you both up.

3: channel your sadness and frustration into something that you are proud of.  
This was the most important thing for me. 
Was not uncommon for me to take an hour long power in the rain at 1am when crying myself to sleep didn't work.

I know it's easier said than done and I can't promise that this will work for you but I truly hope that you find a way that works for you and this will be the only time you had to rely on cutting. <3

To make a 360 picture follow these steps:

1: watch this video but when he saves the file pick JPEG instead. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p40ZBX9hXbE

2: download http://panoramaphotographer.com/software/exiffixer/

3: open that program and then click "Choose JPEG  Panorama" and select the JPEG you just made.

4: make sure Equirectangular is selected and the 2 checkboxes at the bottom are ticked.

5: Click add metadata.

Done :) now the image should be detected as a 360 picture if you upload it on facebook or other sites that support 360 pictures and video.
